slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the demand at each demand point j required to be met exactly (total received equals b_j), or is it allowed to be less than b_j (i.e., some demand may go unmet)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be met exactly or can be unmet, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, which is the sum of all unit transportation costs (for both production-to-station and station-to-demand legs) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about minimizing total cost including both transportation and fixed station costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; remaining questions addressed P2 or boundary details.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved both P0 hidden slots, including exact demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization, then stopped appropriately with no silent assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
